## Bottom line

Single-class conformal set [F1], 0% invasive risk, unflagged input quality, and tier 4 priority.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 83%, InSitu 14%, Normal 2%, Invasive 0% | Strong benign lead; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% target (90% test coverage) | Single class; dataset-level coverage guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | High reliability; atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 3/5 Normal (40%) [F5] | Non-neoplastic; split with normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 5, 6) · context · High score lowers invasive read (-0.75) [F2]; 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Low score reduces invasive read (-0.40) [F3]; unreliable 0/20 check · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low score raises invasive read (+0.23) [F4]; 12/20 spot check · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · High score reduces invasive read (-0.22); unreliable 0/20 check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Low score reduces invasive read (-0.21); 19/20 spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive score more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 spans 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal in situ (14% probability) or invasion is missed; HoVer-Net sampled 3 regions and flagged insufficient tumor nuclei.
- Tissue is normal parenchyma rather than benign lesion, matching 3/5 similar cases (including contrast BACH_0207).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 3**: Inspect the lone nonzero risk tile (0.019) to exclude stromal invasion and verify benign lobules.
2. **Regions 5, 6**: Verify dense lymphocytes versus unreliable necrosis, and check the 2 neoplastic nuclei in region 5.
3. **Regions 8, 10**: Check ducts and nuclear atypia to exclude in situ carcinoma (14% probability).
